items.name: New Rochelle Night Favorites 2 2025
items.information:
# Please read the [Favorites Competition Format](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NewRochelleNightFavorites22025#61248-favorites-competition-format) tab before registering. You are only able to register for a limited number of the events available at this competition.

This competition takes place on a **Tuesday night (7-10pm)**. Only one guest per competitor is permitted.

## This competition will run in 2 groups. You will compete in one group and run, judge, or scramble for the other group. You MUST be present for the entirety of both groups (i.e. 7-10pm), otherwise you will not be allowed to compete.
